Warmachine.description: The Warmachine is the cornerstone of your army.

Jammer Truck.description: The Jammer is effective at neutralizing cloak bonuses and air raids.

Blockade.description: Blockades get in the way of stuff.

Lancer Tank.description: Lancer attacks will hit any unit behind the one you targetted.

Spider Tank.description: The Spider Tank stuns its target to avoid counter attack.

Heavy Commando.description: Heavies like to engage tanks and capture properties.

Strike Commando.description: Enemy Commandos and Trucks fear the property-capturing Strike Commando.

Flak Tank.description: The Flak Tank's cannon shreds aircraft and lightly armored units to pieces.

Scorpion Tank.description: The versatile Scorpion Tank is the back bone of most armed forces.

Mortar Truck.description: The Mortar Truck is a general purpose cost-effective medium range artillery unit.

Rocket Truck.description: Specialized long range unit that can fire on enemy aircraft and tanks.

Annihilator Tank.description: The mammoth Annihilator packs a big punch and knows how to take a beating.

Turret.description: This immobile defensive unit helps deter both ground, sea and air invasions.

Stealth Tank.description: Stealth attack bonuses make this a powerful weapon in the hands of a capable general.

Albatross Transport.description: The Albatross is the fastest way to move Commandos around the map.

Raptor Fighter.description: Effective at engaging air, sea and ground targets.

Vulture Drone.description: A specialized scavenger that can move and attack again, if it kills its target.

Condor Bomber.description: The Condor Bomber is as hardy as it is powerful. It fears only the enemy Raptor.

Leviathan Barge.description: Leviathans transport ground units across the oceans.

Hunter Support.description: Hunters excel at keeping the oceans clear of enemy aircraft and U-boats.

Corvette Fighter.description: The Corvette is the brawler of the seas, capable of engaging most enemy targets effectively.

U-Boat.description: The U-boat's cloak is useful for holding choke points and attacking an entrenched foe.

Battlecruiser.description: The massive guns of the Battlecruiser can fire further than all other units.

Intrepid.description: Use the Intrepid to capture sea properties and warfactories along coast lines.

Enriched Ore Deposit.description: Warmachines can extract Ore from Enriched Ore Deposits.

Depleted Ore Deposit.description: Nothing else can be extracted from this tile.

Ore Deposit.description: Warmachines can extract Ore from Ore Deposits.

Plains.description: Plains slow movement slightly but provide some minimal cover against enemy attacks.

Sea.description: The open sea forms the theater for naval combat.

Road.description: Roads help slower ground units cover long distances quickly, but provide no defensive cover.

Forest.description: Forests will slow wheeled and tracked units, but will provide defensive cover from attacks.

Mountain.description: Mountains are the best place to bunker infantry during an assault or strategic defense.

Desert.description: Infantry units cannot enter the desert.

Reef.description: Reefs slow movement and improves defense against attack.

Shore.description: Shores are the link between the land and sea. Order Leviathan pick ups for ground troops here.

Bridge.description: Bridges are useful for connecting islands of land, but they lack defensive cover.

Command Center.description: This is your base of operations. Do not allow the enemy to capture any Command Center.

Air Control.description: Air Controls enable air unit manufacturing at your warfactories.

Ground Control.description: Ground Controls enable ground unit manufacturing at your warfactories.

Factory.description: Warfactories allow you to build new units.

Sea Control.description: Sea Controls enable sea unit manufacturing at your sea-bordering warfactories.

Oil Refinery.description: The most basic oil producing property. Capture it to establish an income stream.

Advanced Oil Refinery.description: An advanced oil production facility. Capture it to enhance your income stream.

Oil Rig.description: An advanced oil production sea-facility. Capture it with Intrepids to enhance your income stream.

Hill.description: Hills can provide your ranged units with the boost necessary to challenge an entrenched opponent.

Canyon.description: Use Canyons to avoid ranged fire when traversing an area.

Wasteland.description: Wastelands are dangerous to your units but they provide massive defensive bonuses.

Volcano.description: No unit can cross the deadly Volcano.

Archipelago.description: A cluster of small islands providing some defensive cover at the cost of mobility.

Rock Formation.description: The Rock Formation provides heavy defensive cover, but will damage sea units that rest on them.

High Bridge.description: The High Bridge can be crossed by ground units and sailed under by sea units.

Extractable.description: Resources can be extracted from this tile.

Rugged.description: Slows wheeled vehicles and somewhat slows tracked vehicles.

Precipitous.description: Allows only commandos. Severe movement cost.

Shallow.description: Large hulled ships cannot enter shallow waters.

Cover.description: Damage to non-air units reduced by 10%.

Camouflage.description: Damage to ground and sea units reduced by 20%.

Bunker.description: Damage to ground units reduced by 40%.

High Ground.description: Reduces damage received by ranged fire by 25%

Farsight.description: Increases maximum attack range of ranged units by 1.

Garrison.description: Damage to non-air units reduced by 50%

Strait.description: Damage received by sea units is increased by 10%

Tricky Waters.description: Tricky waters severely slow Massive Hull ships and slows all other types.

Hazard.description: Does 20 damage to any non-air units that start their turn on this tile.

Canopy.description: Ranged units cannot fire from this tile.

Shielded.description: Units in Shielded terrain can't be targetted by ranged units.

Construction.description: Controlling team may build new units from this structure.

Air Proficiency.description: Each Air Control reduces cost of deploying air units by 5%.

Ground Proficiency.description: Each Ground Control reduces cost of deploying ground units by 5%.

Sea Proficiency.description: Each Sea Control reduces cost of deploying sea units by 5%.

Level 1 Oil Refining.description: Delivers $60 per round to the controlling team, in equal portions per player turn.

Level 2 Oil Refining.description: Delivers $240 per round to the controlling team, in equal portions per player turn.

Level 3 Oil Refining.description: Delivers $480 per round to the controlling team, in equal portions per player turn.

Mission Critical.description: Losing this structure means defeat (or victory!).

Forest Movement.description: Cada casa de floresta custa um ponto extra de movimento para unidades terrestres.

Air Cover.description: Unidades terrestres na trincheira ficam protegidas de ataques aéreos.

Skysweeper.description: This unit can engage air craft.

Linchpin.description: Keep at least one Linchpin unit alive to stay in the fight.

Scavenge.description: Unit can move and attack again if it kills its target.

Not Selectable.description: This unit isn't selectable. It just sits there.

Piercing.description: Attack damages any unit directly behind target.

Fixed.description: This unit does not prevent military defeat.

Jamming.description: Emits a no-fly zone that also uncloaks stealth units.

Extractor.description: This unit can extract resources from Ore Deposits.

Constructor.description: This unit can build other units.

Cloak Damage.description: This unit does 2x damage because it is cloaked.

Air Bound.description: This unit can engage air units.

Ground Bound.description: This unit can engage ground units.

Mammoth.description: Unit does 15% less damage on counter attack.

Fire Bomb.description: Does 20% more damage if target is on a structure.

Radar.description: Detects stealth units at the start of its turn.

Submerged.description: Can only be attacked by Anti-Sub units.

Tracking.description: Unit will attack stealth units on interception.

Stun.description: Enemy units will not counter-attack in response to an attack.

Sure-Footed.description: Walks without terrain penalties: forests and mountains cost 1 move.
